freeze_binding: Bound by git commit recorded in READINESS.md and by statistics_plan_freeze.json sha256 recorded in STATISTICS_PLAN_FROZEN.md.
identity_unit: frozen DAV product identity case (one official DAV product record)
ddi_unit: frozen logical medication pair/case (accepted identity A x accepted identity B matched to an external positive reference)
clustering_unit: canonical product identity cluster; natural (brand/generic/strength/form/registrant) and noisy (typo/whitespace/punctuation/diacritic) variants of one product resolve to the same cluster key

primary_endpoint.name: end_to_end_false_reassurance
primary_endpoint.definition: Proportion of all frozen externally positive cases for which CareGuard releases a completed reassuring (no-interaction) conclusion when reassurance must not be released, including wrong-identity, ambiguous/unresolved-identity, stale-identity, and DDI-knowledge-miss paths.
primary_endpoint.denominator: ALL frozen externally positive cases in the test set. Identity failure/ambiguity stays in the denominator and cannot be excluded.

secondary_decomposition.name: conditional_ddi_false_clear
secondary_decomposition.definition: False-clear rate among admissibly resolved identities only (denominator excludes identity-failure cases). Decomposition only; not a substitute primary endpoint.

secondary_decomposition.name: identity_accuracy
secondary_decomposition.definition: Proportion of frozen identity cases whose accepted mapping matches the adjudicated frozen identity ledger (review-reference accuracy) and, where independently known, the correct RxCUI. Reported with numerator/denominator and abstention count.

secondary_decomposition.name: abstention_or_clarification
secondary_decomposition.definition: Rate at which CareGuard returns clarification or an unavailable (no-reassurance) conclusion for ambiguous, unresolved, stale, or source-conflicting identities. Reported per identity-resolution state.

secondary_decomposition.name: risk_coverage_grid
secondary_decomposition.definition: Coverage and false-reassurance by stratum: DDInter risk/severity level, identity-resolution state, source-field completeness, and brand-generic invariance stratum. Reported with numerator/denominator per cell; cells may be empty (reported as empty, not zero).

secondary_decomposition.name: error_decomposition
secondary_decomposition.definition: End-to-end false reassurance decomposed into identity-stage error vs DDI-knowledge error via Mode B oracle-identity decomposition on the same frozen inputs.

precision_objective_cg03.statement: Sufficient positive-reference cases that the two-sided 95% interval for a plausible 5-10% false-reassurance rate has half-width <= 3 percentage points.

required_positive_reference_n.note: planning_target_n is the maximum over the plausible range; achieved half-width recomputed by research/careguard_vn/precision_requirement.py

precision_objective_cg03.achieved_precision_fallback: If the mapped eligible positive population cannot meet the target, report the achieved precision with the observed denominator rather than manufacturing pseudo-independent perturbations (CG-03).

sample_selection.rule: Use all eligible frozen externally positive cases, or a prespecified stratified sample/cap. Never stop based on observed performance.
sample_selection.cap: prespecified at source-set freeze; no performance-adaptive stopping

development_test_split.design: Split at the product-identity-case level (never by string); 80% development / 20% locked test prespecified, stratified by registrant and DDInter risk level.
development_test_split.rule: Split is assigned only after source mapping and before any CareGuard result inspection; development-only rows may tune normalization aliases/rules but are never reused as test rows.
development_test_split.status: assignment BLOCKED until authorized DAV identity frame is delivered and mapped

exclusions.rule: Exclusions are prespecified with reason codes before result inspection and recorded in the freeze ledger.

reason_codes.E03: duplicate registration number with conflicting identity fields (source_conflict)
reason_codes.E05: no RxNorm candidate above deterministic threshold
reason_codes.E06: external positive pair has no eligible frozen identity on either side
reason_codes.E07: DailyMed confirmation subset is confirmation-only and never used as a negative or exclusion driver
reason_codes.E08: record not in the frozen source manifest row-hash inventory

vietnam_identity_frame.note: DAV identity frame is the CG-01 external MANUAL gate; no authorized export is available, so the source-set freeze and benchmark remain BLOCKED.

unknown_label_rule: not-in-reference is unknown and excluded from negative/specificity denominators; specificity is UNSUPPORTED (research/careguard_vn/NEGATIVE_REFERENCE.md)

analysis.primary_uncertainty: two-sided 95% Wilson interval for end-to-end false reassurance; Wald half-width only for the CG-03 precision sizing
analysis.paired_comparisons: Exact McNemar where Mode A vs Mode B are paired on identical cases; prespecified contrast families use Holm correction
analysis.clustering: Within-cluster (canonical product identity) dependence acknowledged; primary analysis case-level with cluster-robust inference and a cluster-level sensitivity analysis
analysis.agreement: Cohen's kappa for blinded mapping reviewers per research/careguard_vn/MAPPING_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md

release_rule: Reassurance (completed no-interaction conclusion) is released only for accepted identities bound to a current frozen source record; ambiguous, unresolved, stale, or source-conflicting identities return clarification or an unavailable conclusion and count toward abstention, not toward released reassurance.
non_claims: No negative/specificity claim is made; DDInter absence is not a negative label.
No performance result is claimed; identity failure stays in the primary denominator.
The precision objective records a planning target only; it is not a completed benchmark.
